_what: Pinned role-gate negative coverage. Written by tools/role_gate_negative_coverage.py --baseline. A ratchet: `uncovered` must never rise. Lower it by adding an arm that drives the resource with a role its gate excludes. BUT A RISE IS NOT ALWAYS A REGRESSION: adding a RULE moves resources out of not_driven and into uncovered without the world changing, because the screen could not see them before. That happened on 2026-09-29 -- the resource-table rule took uncovered 12 -> 17 and not_driven 16 -> 11 in one commit, and nothing about the gates changed. Across a rule change the two pins are not comparable; the commit that re-pins has to say which it was.
